learned_runtime_preflight.fixed_demo_pilot_scope: One fixed, in-sample-adjacent M10 demo pilot only; not general M10 full-loop promotion, success-rate evidence, unseen-position evidence, or production authority.

policy_description: Run-local M10 proposed learned-posterior plus residual entropy search; identical policy to the M12 mode with the M10 printed CAD geometry and a 5.0 mm socket depth.  This invocation was selected by a fixed private demo campaign; the private offset is consumed only by the pre-touchdown air transport and is never supplied to learned or CAD routing.

conical_phase_pose_tracking_qualificatio.rule: Only an independently measured, timestamp-aligned cone pose trace can make a clean sample an offline training candidate.  Command-propagated DirectServo pose rows are diagnostics only.

tooling_commissioning_gate.rule: Full-loop motion uses the field-proven predecessor commissioning level: 92 mm axial TCP, manual stationary near-hole start, WORLD-aligned fixture axes, fresh touchdown/capture local datum and 5.0 mm size-correct segmented insertion for active M10.  Missing physical IDs, payload/CoM/inertia, pivot and fixture metrology are disclosed but do not block this fixed experimental compatibility entry.

controller_load_handling.rule: The predecessor successfully used KST geometry-only tool registration plus same-run relative Bota baselines; strict Sunrise LoadData/readback attestation remains unqualified and is disclosed rather than treated as motion authority.
